oracles.C01: SELECT c.id, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity*l.unit_cents),0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id AND o.status='paid' LEFT JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.id
oracles.C02: SELECT c.id FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id AND o.status='paid')
oracles.C03: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
oracles.C04: SELECT customer_id,id FROM (SELECT customer_id,id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ordered_on DESC,id DESC) AS r FROM orders WHERE status='paid') WHERE r=1
oracles.C05: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity*l.unit_cents),0) FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.ordered_on>='2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_on<'2025-02-01'
oracles.C06: SELECT c.id,COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity*l.unit_cents),0) AS revenue FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id AND o.status='paid' LEFT JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenue DESC,c.id ASC LIMIT 2
oracles.C07: SELECT l.sku FROM lines l JOIN orders o ON o.id=l.order_id WHERE o.status='paid'
oracles.C08: SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' AND l.sku IN ('A','B') GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.sku)=2
oracles.S01: SELECT a.id,COUNT(t.id) FROM agents a LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.agent_id=a.id GROUP BY a.id
oracles.S02: SELECT a.id FROM agents a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id=a.id AND t.resolved_on IS NULL)
oracles.S03: SELECT ticket_id,COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE kind='reply' GROUP BY ticket_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
oracles.S04: SELECT ticket_id,id FROM (SELECT ticket_id,id,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY happened_on ASC,id ASC) AS r FROM events WHERE kind='reply') WHERE r=1
oracles.S05: SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE opened_on>='2025-01-01' AND opened_on<'2025-02-01' AND (resolved_on IS NULL OR resolved_on>='2025-02-01')
oracles.S06: SELECT id,priority FROM tickets WHERE resolved_on IS NULL ORDER BY priority DESC,id ASC LIMIT 3
oracles.S07: SELECT DISTINCT a.team FROM agents a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id=a.id)
oracles.S08: SELECT a.id FROM agents a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id=a.id AND t.priority>=2) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id=a.id AND t.priority=0)
oracles.B01: SELECT i.id,i.total_cents-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents),0) FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.id GROUP BY i.id
oracles.B02: WITH balances AS (SELECT i.account_id,i.total_cents-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_cents),0) AS balance FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id=i.id GROUP BY i.id) SELECT account_id,SUM(balance) FROM balances GROUP BY account_id HAVING SUM(balance)>0
oracles.B03: SELECT i.id FROM invoices i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.id)
oracles.B04: SELECT a.id FROM accounts a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.account_id=a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.account_id=a.id AND i.total_cents>COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_cents) FROM payments p WHERE p.invoice_id=i.id),0))
oracles.B05: SELECT SUBSTR(issued_on,1,7) AS month,SUM(total_cents) FROM invoices GROUP BY SUBSTR(issued_on,1,7) ORDER BY month ASC
oracles.B06: SELECT invoice_id,id,SUM(amount_cents) OVER(PARTITION BY invoice_id ORDER BY paid_on,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM payments ORDER BY invoice_id,paid_on,id
oracles.B07: SELECT a.plan,AVG(i.total_cents) FROM accounts a JOIN invoices i ON i.account_id=a.id GROUP BY a.plan
oracles.B08: SELECT a.id FROM accounts a WHERE a.active=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices i WHERE i.account_id=a.id AND i.issued_on>='2025-01-01' AND i.issued_on<'2025-02-01')
